fields.definition: A query or batch executed concurrently across every shard of a `ShardSet` (or the subset specified by `ShardsValues`), where each shard runs on its own connection with its own cloned parameter set under its own resilience policy. `ShardSet` provides three fan-out modes: `ReadAll` (combines all non-null shard results), `ReadFirst` (returns the first non-null result and cancels remaining shards), and `Write` (executes on shard write connections and lets all shards finish).
fields.name: Fan-out query
